_note: Admin Help center content. scripts/help-shots.mjs opens each topic's path, runs its steps, masks customer details ([data-pii]) and saves public/help/<slug>.jpg plus marker positions (lib/admin/help-markers.json) for each callout's selector. Edit text freely; re-run the script after changing a selector or the screen itself.

topics.title: Getting around the admin
topics.intro: Everything is reached from the dark menu on the left. Groups open and close; the page you are on is highlighted in gold.

callouts.title: Main menu
callouts.body: Dashboard, Bookings, Customers, Fleet, Trips, Reports and Admin. Click a group with an arrow to open it.

callouts.title: Badges
callouts.body: Gold numbers count work waiting for you: new pending bookings, and uploaded receipts to verify.

callouts.title: New booking
callouts.body: Opens the Calendar, where you pick a boat and night and assign a booking for a customer who called or messaged.

callouts.title: Sign out
callouts.body: Always sign out on a shared phone or computer.

topics.title: Dashboard and Harbour HQ
topics.intro: Harbour HQ shows tonight's trip at Jeti Marang, played out on the real clock: boats with bookings board at 15:30, sail from 16:45, fish at the lubuk through the night and come home at 06:00. This picture uses Demo mode at 17:20.

callouts.title: Tonight at a glance
callouts.body: Which trip night is showing and how many boats sail. Before 07:30 it is still last night's trip.

callouts.title: Live, Play day, Demo
callouts.body: Live follows the clock. Play day runs the whole trip in under a minute. Demo books every boat so you can watch it on a quiet night; it never changes real bookings.

callouts.title: The harbour
callouts.body: Click a boat or its name tag to see who is on board tonight. A storm cloud means a weather hold.

callouts.title: Time slider
callouts.body: Drag to any time of the trip day to see where the boats will be.

callouts.title: Today's numbers
callouts.body: Deposits due, nights sold this week, money collected this month and open slots in the next 30 nights.

topics.title: All bookings
topics.intro: Every booking, newest night first. Use the tabs, filters and search to find one, then View to open it.

callouts.title: Status tabs
callouts.body: Pending, Deposit due, Confirmed, Weather hold and Cancelled. The numbers count every booking and do not change when you search.

callouts.title: Show
callouts.body: How many bookings per page: 10, 20, 50 or All.

callouts.title: Boat filter
callouts.body: Only one boat's bookings.

callouts.title: Search
callouts.body: Type part of a name, a booking reference (CS-…) or a phone number in any format.

callouts.title: View
callouts.body: Opens the booking: pax list, deposit, receipt, notes and Cancel.

callouts.title: WhatsApp
callouts.body: Opens a WhatsApp chat with the customer.

callouts.title: Pages
callouts.body: How many are shown, and page numbers when there are more.

topics.title: Payments
topics.intro: Deposits: receipts customers uploaded, waiting for you to check against the bank, and bookings still waiting to pay.

callouts.title: To verify first
callouts.body: To verify lists uploaded receipts not yet accepted. Awaiting deposit lists bookings with no receipt yet.

callouts.title: Receipt
callouts.body: View receipt opens the customer's upload for two minutes. Receipts are private and never public links.

callouts.title: Verify
callouts.body: When the money is in the bank, Verify marks the deposit paid and confirms the booking. It asks before saving.

topics.title: Calendar
topics.intro: One boat's nights, month by month. Assign a booking for a customer, or block a night for weather or maintenance.

callouts.title: Choose a boat
callouts.body: The calendar shows one boat at a time.

callouts.title: Month
callouts.body: Move between the months of the season.

callouts.title: Nights
callouts.body: Green is open, gold is filling up, red is full or blocked. Click a night to select it.

callouts.title: Selected night
callouts.body: Assign booking adds a booking for a customer. Block night stops sales for weather or repairs; Unblock opens it again.

topics.title: Customers
topics.intro: Everyone who has booked, grouped by phone number. 0123…, 60123… and +60 12-3… are the same customer.

callouts.title: Who to look at
callouts.body: Upcoming trip, Repeat customers (2 or more trips) and One-trip customers.

callouts.title: Search
callouts.body: By name, email or phone number.

callouts.title: Customer value
callouts.body: Trips taken, last and next trip, the value of their bookings and the deposits they have paid.

callouts.title: Profile
callouts.body: Every booking this customer has made, with a WhatsApp button.

topics.title: Fleet
topics.intro: Your boats as customers see them on the website.

callouts.title: Active and inactive
callouts.body: Inactive boats are not offered on the website or in the calendar. Boats are never deleted, because bookings point at them.

callouts.title: Add boat
callouts.body: A new boat needs its nights opened in Settings → Season before customers can book it.

callouts.title: Jetty
callouts.body: Where each boat sails from. Use the jetty filter above the table to see one jetty's boats.

callouts.title: Upcoming
callouts.body: Bookings on this boat for nights still to come.

callouts.title: Edit
callouts.body: Change any detail: name, skipper, capacity, size, rate, photo link and description.

topics.title: Editing a boat
topics.intro: Every detail the website shows about a boat.

callouts.title: Details
callouts.body: Code is the number on the hull plate. Kind, description, capacity, size and rate are shown to customers.

callouts.title: Jetty
callouts.body: The jetty this boat sails from. The homepage search shows it only under that jetty. A boat at a Coming Soon jetty cannot be booked.

callouts.title: Active
callouts.body: Untick to take the boat off sale. Bookings already on it stay.

callouts.title: Preview
callouts.body: The photo and 3D model update as you type, so you can check before saving.

callouts.title: Save
callouts.body: Changes show on the website on its next load.

topics.title: Packages
topics.intro: The trip customers book: its title, photo, itinerary and FAQ.

callouts.title: Package
callouts.body: The price per pax and the season shown on the website.

callouts.title: Edit page
callouts.body: The page builder for the title, subtitle, cover photo, itinerary and FAQ.

topics.title: Insights
topics.intro: Money collected over the season and how each boat is doing.

callouts.title: Collected this season
callouts.body: Deposits received, month by month, for the season set in Settings.

callouts.title: By boat
callouts.body: Nights sold and deposits collected for each boat.

topics.title: Settings: season and deposit
topics.intro: The season dates drive every calendar on the website and in the admin.

callouts.title: Season and deposit
callouts.body: Start and end dates of the season, and the deposit per boat for new bookings. Saving is refused if a live booking would fall outside the new dates.

callouts.title: Nights on sale
callouts.body: Open adds every upcoming night for every active boat (use it after adding a boat). Close takes a month off sale; bookings already taken stay.

callouts.title: WhatsApp number
callouts.body: The number customers reach from the website's WhatsApp buttons.

topics.title: Unpaid bookings
topics.intro: How long an unpaid booking keeps its night before it is released automatically.

callouts.title: Hold time
callouts.body: Hours a booking with no payment and no receipt holds the boat-night. After that it is cancelled, the night goes back on sale and the bell shows "Hold expired". The terms page shows the same number.

callouts.title: Not retroactive
callouts.body: Bookings made before this was switched on (15 Oct 2026) never expire on their own; cancel them by hand if they will not pay.

topics.title: Jetties
topics.intro: The jetty list on the homepage search and map.

callouts.title: Name and subtitle
callouts.body: The name appears in the search menu; the subtitle under it and on each boat card, e.g. "Jeti Marang, Terengganu".

callouts.title: Map position
callouts.body: Right-click the jetty in Google Maps and copy the two numbers: latitude first, then longitude.

callouts.title: Open or Coming Soon
callouts.body: Only open jetties take bookings. Coming Soon jetties show on the map and in the menu so customers know they are on the way.

callouts.title: Save and boats
callouts.body: Saves the row. The number shows how many active boats sail from it; assign boats in Fleet → Edit.

topics.title: Users & roles
topics.intro: Who can sign in to the admin, and what they can see. Admins see everything; vendors see only their own boats' bookings and calendar.

callouts.title: The team
callouts.body: Everyone with an account. Switch off removes someone's access at once without deleting their history; Boats changes which boats a vendor manages.

callouts.title: Invite someone
callouts.body: Name, email (their sign-in) and phone. They get a link to choose a password; it works for 7 days.

callouts.title: Admin or vendor
callouts.body: A vendor picks the boats they own. They never see payments, customers, settings or other boats.

callouts.title: Invitations waiting
callouts.body: New link sends a fresh link (the old one stops working). Revoke cancels it. After sending, the link and a WhatsApp button appear once.

topics.title: Activity log
topics.intro: Every change to bookings, payments, boats, the season and the team, with who made it. Customers booking on the website show as Website.

callouts.title: What kind
callouts.body: Bookings, Payments, Fleet, Season & prices, Team and Customers.

callouts.title: Who
callouts.body: Only one person's changes.

callouts.title: Search
callouts.body: Find a booking reference, a boat code or a name.
